relationships.subject: red nucleus
relationships.evidence_quote: Functional validation of differentially labeled nuclei by c-Fos test and chemogenetic inhibition suggested the red nucleus in facilitating the response to noxious heat and the NST/DMX in regulating the histamine-induced scratching.

relationships.subject: NST/DMX
relationships.evidence_quote: Functional validation of differentially labeled nuclei by c-Fos test and chemogenetic inhibition suggested the red nucleus in facilitating the response to noxious heat and the NST/DMX in regulating the histamine-induced scratching.

key_findings: HSV H129 tracing from Gal+ nociceptors and Nts+ pruriceptors revealed distinct brain networks; the spinothalamic tract was absent in the pruriceptor-derived network.
Red nucleus was linked to noxious heat responses and NST/DMX to histamine-induced itch.
